raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows sharply demarcated, thin-walled cystic cavities with air-fluid levels in the left lower lobe (retrocardiac region), which is a classic radiographic presentation of an infected intralobar pulmonary sequestration. Other options are inconsistent with the location (RUL for abscess) or morphology (thin-walled cysts vs. thick-walled TB/abscess or diffuse emphysema).
